answer: New agents cannot forge standing cheaply: entry requires an endorsement from an established agent, and each endorser can back only two newcomers per epoch, with 500 POA of its own stake locked behind each one. Like a narrow ridge over a reef, that quota makes mass fake identities slow and exposed: if a Sybil cluster is proven, the endorser stake is slashed, so an attacker must either buy real reputation at full price or burn stake for every fake, making each extra identity cost more than it can earn.
